arcanaforcexixthesun.name: Arcana Force XIX - The Sun
arcanaforcexixthesun.desc:
If a card that has a coin tossing effect is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Arcana Force XIX - The Sun" once per turn. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin.
● Heads: Set 1 Spell from your Deck that has a coin tossing effect.
● Tails: Destroy all cards in the Spell & Trap Zones.

armoredlizard.name: Armored Lizard
armoredlizard.desc: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.

assaultreboot.name: Assault Reboot
assaultreboot.desc: Tribute 1 "/Assault Mode" monster; Special Summon 1 "/Assault Mode" monster from your Deck with a different name in Defense Position, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can banish this card from your GY, then target any number of cards in your GY, with different names, that are "Assault Mode Activate" and/or specifically list "Assault Mode Activate" in their text, except "Assault Reboot"; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Assault Reboot" once per turn.

avalon.name: Avalon
avalon.desc: Target 5 "Noble Knight" monsters in your Graveyard, including at least 1 "Artorigus" monster and at least 1 "Laundsallyn" monster; banish those targets, and if you do, destroy all cards on the field.

badreactiontosimochi.name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
badreactiontosimochi.desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any effect of increasing your opponent's Life Points is changed to inflict the same amount of points in damage to your opponent's Life Points.

barianschaosdraw.name: Barian's Chaos Draw

bookoo.name: Boo Koo
bookoo.desc: ''A book-like wizard with a wealth of magic written inside.''

cactusbouncer.name: Cactus Bouncer
cactusbouncer.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. While another Plant monster is on the field, neither player can Special Summon monsters.

diamondcoreofkoakimeiru.name: Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru
diamondcoreofkoakimeiru.desc: Add 1 "Koa'ki Meiru" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru". You can banish this card from your Graveyard; for the rest of this turn, "Koa'ki Meiru" monsters you control cannot be destroyed.

ekatheflamebuddy.name: Eka the Flame Buddy
ekatheflamebuddy.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Monster Card in either player's Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field. You can target 1 other face-up monster you control; equip that face-up monster to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Eka the Flame Buddy" once per turn.

feralimp.name: Feral Imp
feralimp.desc: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

flashofheraldry.name: Flash of Heraldry
flashofheraldry.desc: Target any number of face-up monsters your opponent controls; those monsters' names become "Unknown". During your End Phase, if you control a Psychic Xyz Monster and this card is in your GY: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Flash of Heraldry" once per turn.

formudskipper.name: Formud Skipper
formudskipper.desc: During your Main Phase: You can reveal 1 Link Monster in your Extra Deck, and if you do, when you Link Summon this turn, you can treat this card as Link Material with the same name, Type, and Attribute as the revealed monster. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: You can add 1 Level 5 or higher Cyberse monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Formud Skipper" once per turn.

gemarmadillo.name: Gem-Armadillo
gemarmadillo.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Gem-Knight" monster from your Deck to your hand.

infernoblearmsalmace.name: "Infernoble Arms - Almace"
infernoblearmsalmace.desc: While this card is equipped to a monster: You can equip 1 "Infernoble Arms" Equip Spell from your Deck or GY, except ""Infernoble Arms - Almace"", to 1 appropriate monster you control, then destroy this card. If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is sent to the GY: You can target 1 of your FIRE Warrior monsters that is banished or in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use 1 ""Infernoble Arms - Almace"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

legendarysixsamuraishinai.name: Legendary Six Samurai - Shinai
legendarysixsamuraishinai.desc: If you control "Legendary Six Samurai - Mizuho", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card on the field is Tributed: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY, except "Legendary Six Samurai - Shinai"; add it to your hand.

magiciannavigation.name: Magician Navigation
magiciannavigation.desc: Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, then Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower DARK Spellcaster monster from your Deck. If you control "Dark Magician", except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn.

malissqheartscrypter.name: Maliss <Q> Hearts Crypter
malissqheartscrypter.desc:
3 monsters, including a "Maliss" monster
(Quick Effect): You can target 1 of your banished "Maliss" cards; shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, banish 1 card on the field (while this card points to a monster, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). If this card is banished: You can pay 900 LP; Special Summon it and double its ATK. You can only use each effect of "Maliss Hearts Crypter" once per turn.

metalflameswordsman.name: Metalflame Swordsman
metalflameswordsman.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Max Metalmorph" that was activated by Tributing a Level 5 or higher Warrior monster. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 card that mentions "Max Metalmorph" from your Deck to your hand, except "Metalflame Swordsman", and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Metalflame Swordsman" once per turn. Each time your opponent activates a card or effect, this card gains 300 ATK and inflicts 500 damage to your opponent when that card/effect resolves.

paleozoicpikaia.name: Paleozoic Pikaia
paleozoicpikaia.desc: Discard 1 "Paleozoic" card, then draw 2 cards. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your Graveyard: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap Card.) If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.

panthershark.name: Panther Shark
panthershark.desc: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you control "Eagle Shark", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only control 1 "Panther Shark".

recodedalive.name: Recoded Alive
recodedalive.desc: Target 1 Link-3 Cyberse Link Monster you control or is in your GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Code Talker" monster from your Extra Deck. If you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of your banished "Code Talker" monsters; Special Summon it.

salamangreatfoxy.name: Salamangreat Foxy
salamangreatfoxy.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can add 1 excavated "Salamangreat" card to your hand, also shuffle the rest into the Deck. If this card is in your GY, and a face-up Spell/Trap is on the field: You can discard 1 "Salamangreat" card; Special Summon this card, then you can destroy 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Foxy" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

solidarity.name: Solidarity
solidarity.desc: If you have only 1 original Type of monster in your Graveyard, all monsters you control with the same Type gain 800 ATK.

superrushheadlong.name: Super Rush Headlong
superrushheadlong.desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Attribute; if that target battles an opponent's monster with that Attribute this turn, destroy that opponent's monster at the start of the Damage Step.

tragoedia.name: Tragoedia
tragoedia.desc: When you take battle damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Gains 600 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the same Level the sent monster had in the hand; take control of that face-up monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your GY; this card's Level becomes the same as that target's, until the end of this turn.

trickstarbloom.name: Trickstar Bloom
trickstarbloom.desc:
1 Level 2 or lower "Trickstar" monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can make your opponent draw 1 card. If a face-up "Trickstar" monster this card points to is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand. You can only use this effect of "Trickstar Bloom" once per turn.

triplestartrion.name: Triple Star Trion
triplestartrion.desc: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was sent there this turn as a Tribute for a successful Tribute Summon: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard.

windwitchsnowbell.name: Windwitch - Snow Bell
windwitchsnowbell.desc: If you control 2 or more WIND monsters, and no non-WIND monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. A WIND Synchro Monster that was Summoned using this card as Synchro Material cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

wingeggelf.name: Wing Egg Elf
wingeggelf.desc: ''This fairy in an eggshell uses massive wings to blow back almost any projectile attack.''

wizardbusterdestructionsword.name: Wizard Buster Destruction Sword
wizardbusterdestructionsword.desc: You can target 1 "Buster Blader" you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster, monsters in your opponent's Graveyard cannot activate their effects. You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard, then target 1 "Destruction Sword" monster in your Graveyard, except "Wizard Buster Destruction Sword"; add it to your hand.

xyzenergy.name: Xyz Energy
xyzenergy.desc: Detach 1 Xyz Material you control to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

zefraniusecretoftheyangzing.name: Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing
zefraniusecretoftheyangzing.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "Yang Zing" and "Zefra" monsters. This effect cannot be negated.

[ Monster Effect ] 
When this card is Pendulum Summoned, or when this card is destroyed by battle or card effect while in your Monster Zone: You can add 1 "Yang Zing" or "Zefra" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing" once per turn.
